Woman Allegedly Assaulted, Stripped at Guwahati Nightclub; Manager, Others Arrested

A woman was allegedly assaulted and stripped by bouncers at a nightclub in Guwahati. A video of the incident has emerged. Police have filed a suo motu case and arrested seven people, including the club manager. The club was reportedly open after midnight, raising questions about its operation. The incident involved a clash between the woman customer and female bouncers, with a security guard reportedly sharing details.
